description: Find caves by name (also other spellings), region, country, maximum depth or the certification level a team has. Returns a short line per cave with its page; use get_cave for the details and warnings.

certification.description: The team's cave level (ow, cavern, intro, full): only caves that need at most this.

includeClosed.description: Also closed and information-only caves (default false).

lang.description: Language of the texts: nl, en (default), fr, es or de.

maxDepth.description: Only caves whose known maximum depth is at most this many metres.

name: search_caves
title: Search caves
